name: KiPI
description: Power Integrity Simulator: DC drop, AC PDN impedance over frequency, and PSU coupled noise, with 3D visualization of the board's real copper.
description_full:
KiPI is a power integrity analyzer for KiCad boards.

DC: IR drop, current density with flow arrows, via and pad currents, and copper temperature from Joule heating, shown in 3D on the board's real copper.

AC: PDN impedance over frequency at each load, against its target impedance, with the board's planes, vias, decoupling capacitors (SPICE or S-parameter models) and VRMs.

KiPI installs its Python dependencies (NumPy, SciPy, PySide6, PyVista and others, about 250 MB) into the plugin's environment the first time it starts. It also runs on its own, with a launcher, and imports boards from other layout tools.
